name: AI Strategy & Discovery
tagline: You can't build what you haven't defined.
overview: Before any implementation, AIQUIRE helps you understand where you are, where AI can take you, and exactly how to get there — using Design Thinking to ensure every decision is grounded in your business reality.
design_thinking_note: Every strategy engagement is anchored in Design Thinking. This means we start with empathy — understanding your business, your customers, your people — before we ever propose a solution. We use structured ideation workshops, assumption-testing, and rapid prototyping to ensure the strategy we hand you is one that will actually work in your specific context.

services.name: AI Readiness Assessment
services.pricing_tier: Growing SMBs and Mid-Market organisations starting their AI journey

name: AI Productivity & Copilots
tagline: The fastest way to show your organisation what AI can do is to put it in the hands of your people — immediately.
overview: AIQUIRE deploys and configures the AI productivity tools your teams are already asking for, with the training and governance to make adoption stick.
design_thinking_note: Tool configuration is the easy part. We invest as much effort in change management and training as we do in technical setup — because an AI tool nobody uses is a sunk cost, not an asset. Every deployment includes structured onboarding, a prompt library, and 30 days of post-deployment support.

name: Customer & Revenue AI
tagline: The most visible ROI from AI comes at the customer and revenue layer.
overview: Whether you need 24/7 support without headcount, smarter prospecting, or AI-powered content at scale — AIQUIRE implements it with the precision your brand demands.
design_thinking_note: Before we configure any tool in this practice, we run a customer journey mapping session with your team. We identify the moments where AI creates genuine value — and the moments where it would feel robotic and damage trust. This is the Design Thinking difference: we design for the customer experience first, then choose the technology.

name: Operations & Intelligence
tagline: The biggest efficiency gains from AI are hiding in your operations.
overview: AIQUIRE identifies and eliminates bottlenecks in manual processes, document-heavy workflows, and underutilised data — turning operational drag into competitive advantage.
design_thinking_note: Every Operations & Intelligence engagement begins with a process discovery workshop. Using Design Thinking methodology, we map your current workflows, identify friction points, and prioritise automation candidates by effort, impact, and risk. The result: a targeted implementation plan with a clear ROI case — not a wish list.

services.name: Custom RAG System
services.pricing_tier: Mid-Market organisations with significant internal documentation

name: Custom AI Development
tagline: When off-the-shelf AI tools reach their limits, AIQUIRE builds what doesn't exist yet.
overview: Custom AI agents, bespoke workflows, and purpose-built automation — engineered to your exact business requirements.
design_thinking_note: Every custom development engagement begins with a structured design sprint — where we define the problem, prototype the solution, and validate it with real users before we write production code. We also apply SentienzBay's security review process to every custom build — because custom AI agents with tool access and API integrations require rigorous testing before they go near production systems.
